title: Large Language Models are biased to overestimate profoundness
reasoning: The paper investigates the perception of 'pseudo-profound bullshit' in LLMs. While the stimuli include metaphysical and spiritual terminology (e.g., 'spiritual creativity', 'karmic complexity'), the study's focus is on the cognitive and linguistic bias of overestimating profoundness in syntactically correct but meaningless text, rather than a normative evaluation or benchmarking of religious, spiritual, or ethical systems.
